description: This file defines a ChartPlugin class for managing chart components, metadata, and related registries in a charting library, including lazy-loading mechanisms and plugin registration logic.

classes.name: ChartPlugin
classes.description: A plugin class for managing chart components, metadata, and registries with support for lazy-loading and configuration.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a ChartPlugin instance with provided configuration, setting up lazy-loading loaders and control panel.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers the plugin's metadata, component, control panel, transform props, and build query loaders with respective registries.

methods.name: unregister
methods.description: Removes the plugin's entries from all registries.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the plugin with new settings, optionally replacing existing configuration.
